title: Van Rysel Drops Weight and Adds Aero to the New RCR-R Lineup
content:
Developed directly with the Decathlon CMA CGM WorldTour team, the second-generation RCR-R platform drops weight and blends lessons from the dedicated aero bike.

Read the full article at Van Rysel Drops Weight and Adds Aero to the New RCR-R Lineup on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
